vessels.name: Mövenpick MS Royal Lily
vessels.summary: A five-star Mövenpick cruiser with 56 Standard Cabins of about 22 m² and four Royal Suites, sailing between Luxor and Aswan on three-, four- and seven-night cruises.
vessels.description:
The Mövenpick MS Royal Lily is a five-star deluxe Nile cruise ship offering an elegant journey between Luxor and Aswan. Contemporary furnishings, welcoming hospitality and comfortable cabins make it an easy way to discover the temples of Upper Egypt.

As one of Mövenpick's flagship Nile cruisers, Royal Lily spares guests the change of hotels between destinations. The ship sails past villages, fields, palm groves and historic towns, with the temples of Karnak and Luxor, the royal tombs of the West Bank, Edfu, Kom Ombo and Philae all within reach.

On board: a main restaurant and lounge bar, a sun deck with an outdoor pool, Nile-view seating, reception and cultural entertainment. Meals are full board, as the booked package sets out.

Four-night cruises usually leave Luxor on Mondays and three-night cruises leave Aswan on Fridays, with seasonal gaps. This is the usual pattern, not live availability.
vessels.verification_note: Reservations: royal.lily@movenpick.com. Confirm Royal Suite size, deck assignments, child policy, excursions and rates. The seven-night programme was not imported: it needs the supplier's own itinerary.

vessels.name: Mövenpick MS Sun Ray
vessels.summary: A five-star Mövenpick cruiser with a grand lobby and 66 cabins and suites, among them two Junior and two Senior Suites, leaving Luxor on Thursdays and Aswan on Mondays.
vessels.description:
The Mövenpick MS Sun Ray (also written Sunray) is a five-star deluxe Nile cruise ship with an impressive high-ceilinged entrance lobby, spacious public areas and contemporary furnishings. Its cruises link Luxor, Edfu, Kom Ombo and Aswan, combining temple visits with a relaxed atmosphere on board.

Lower-deck Classic Cabins look out through two fixed portholes; upper-deck cabins have larger windows, some of which partly open. There are two suites in each of four categories: Junior, Superior, Deluxe and Executive.

On board: an outdoor pool and sun deck, a main restaurant and lounge bar, a reading room and a playroom.

Four-night cruises usually leave Luxor on Thursdays and three-night cruises leave Aswan on Mondays, a different week from most other Mövenpick ships. This is the usual pattern, not live availability.

vessels.name: Mövenpick SB Feddya
vessels.summary: A boutique Mövenpick dahabiya with only four suites, sailing tailor-made six-night voyages from Luxor to Aswan with stops at El Kab, Ramadi Village and Gebel El Silsila.
vessels.description:
The Mövenpick SB Feddya is a boutique luxury dahabiya for an intimate sail between Luxor and Aswan. Inspired by Egypt's historic sailing boats, it combines personal hospitality, the feel of a private yacht and an unhurried cultural programme.

With only four suites, Feddya suits a private charter, couples, families or small groups. Its six-night voyage adds lesser-visited sites, El Kab, Ramadi Village and Gebel El Silsila, to the famous temples, with quiet island moorings along the way. The vessel docks at its own landing in Al Bughdadi, near Luxor.

Departures are tailor-made, subject to availability; there is no weekly sailing day.
vessels.verification_note: Reservations: Cruise.Feddya@movenpick.com. Tailor-made: the itinerary was imported inactive with no sailing weekday; never generate weekly departures. Suites (checked 5 November 2026): 2 Panorama Suites of 24 m² with an 8 m² balcony and 2 Senior Suites of 22.5 m² with an 8 m² patio (Memphis Tours; Mövenpick's fact sheet gives 4 suites of 22.5–24 m² with private outdoor space, 8 guests, 47.5 × 7.5 m). Confirm bedding and where each suite sits: the fact sheet's plan is unlabelled, so no deck drawing yet. The Mövenpick PDF once listed here (msa_d_0000255.pdf) is about a resort in Bintan, not Feddya: remove it from the vessel's sources. Confirm charter terms, special tomb tickets (Seti I, Tutankhamun), guiding and transfers.

vessels.name: Mövenpick SS Misr
vessels.summary: A historic royal-era steamer, built in 1918, with 16 cabins (two of them singles) and eight suites, sailing between Luxor and Aswan.
vessels.description:
The Mövenpick SS Misr is a historic luxury Nile steamer with a royal-era atmosphere. Built in 1918 for the British Royal Navy and later converted into a luxury steamer associated with King Farouk, it recreates the golden age of river travel. Classic interiors and few cabins make it quite unlike a modern motor cruiser.

The ship is 63 m long and 13.8 m wide. It has 14 Outside Cabins of about 21 m², two Single Cabins of about 14.5 m² for travellers on their own (unusual on the Nile), six Suites of about 30 m² and two Panorama Suites of about 35 m².

On board: a main restaurant, a lounge and bar, a large sun deck with an outdoor pool, and elegant classic common rooms.

Four-night cruises leave Luxor on Mondays on published dates; departures are selected dates, not a continuous weekly service.
vessels.verification_note: Reservations: Cruise.Misr@movenpick.com. Height 11.75 m. Published departures are selected dates, not every week: add only confirmed 2027 dates. The three-night Aswan–Luxor programme was not imported (no day-by-day detail). Confirm Panorama Suite bedding and windows.

Sonesta Dahabeya Amirat offers a graceful, traditional luxury sail between Luxor and Aswan. With only five Deluxe Cabins and two Elegant Suites, it feels more like a private yacht than a motor cruise. vessels.description:
Sonesta Star Goddess is an exclusive all-suite Nile cruiser with only 33 suites, each with a private terrace. Named after classical composers, its Beethoven, Mozart and Chopin Suites give far more room than standard cabins. The ship pairs refined interiors and panoramic river views with fine dining and temple visits between Luxor and Aswan.

There are 27 Beethoven Suites of about 40 m², four Mozart Suites of about 35 m² and two Chopin Suites of about 52 m², the largest, with a spa-style bathroom. Every suite has double-glazed panoramic French windows.

On board: a main restaurant, a lounge bar, a sun deck with an outdoor pool and bar, barbecue facilities, reception and cultural entertainment.

Four-night cruises usually leave Luxor on Saturdays and three-night cruises leave Aswan on Wednesdays. This is the usual pattern, not live availability.
vessels.verification_note: All-suite: never add a standard cabin category. Confirm suite availability per date and the sightseeing after disembarkation in Luxor. Seven-night round trips not imported.

vessels.summary: An all-suite Sonesta cruiser launched in 2020: 30 suites, every one with a private terrace, including Family, Executive and Royal Suites of about 60 m², leaving Luxor on Mondays and Aswan on Fridays.
vessels.description:
Sonesta Sun Goddess is an all-suite luxury Nile cruiser launched in 2020. Its 30 suites, each with a private terrace, make an intimate, contemporary base for exploring Luxor, Edfu, Kom Ombo and Aswan.

There are 26 Presidential Suites of about 40 m², and one Executive and one Royal Suite of about 60 m²; the Royal Suite has its own Jacuzzi. Two Family Suites of about 60 m² have connecting arrangements suited to families. All suites are non-smoking, and in-suite dining runs until midnight.

On board: a main restaurant, an outdoor pool and hot tub, a sun deck, a bar and lounge, entertainment and cultural excursions.

Four-night cruises usually leave Luxor on Mondays and three-night cruises leave Aswan on Fridays. This is the usual pattern, not live availability.

vessels.name: The Oberoi Philae
vessels.summary: An ultra-luxury Oberoi cruiser with only 22 cabins and suites from 36 m², Egyptologist-led sightseeing and private docking, on four- and six-night cruises that can add Dendera and Abydos.
vessels.description:
The Oberoi Philae is an ultra-luxury Nile cruiser for guests who want privacy, space, exceptional hospitality and carefully planned visits to the sites. With only 22 cabins and suites, private docking, professional Egyptologists and luxury vehicles for sightseeing, it is an intimate alternative to the usual cruise ship. Longer itineraries add Dendera and Abydos to the classic Luxor–Aswan journey.

Luxury Cabins measure about 36 m², with king or twin beds and soundproof windows that open. Luxury Suites of about 55 m² add a separate living room, a changing room and a standalone bathtub. Luxury Suites with Terrace add a private terrace (about 85 m² in all) with a heated outdoor whirlpool.

On board: fine dining, a lounge, a sun deck, cultural talks and Wi-Fi. Guiding in other languages can be arranged with notice.
vessels.verification_note: Reservations: reservations.philae@oberoihotels.com. Oberoi sails on published dates, not a weekly day, so the itineraries were imported inactive: add departures from the sailing-dates page and set the sailing days before activating. Low-water variants not imported (keep them separate). Category counts unknown. Confirm special tomb tickets and guide languages.

vessels.name: The Oberoi Zahra
vessels.summary: An ultra-luxury Oberoi cruiser with 28 cabins and suites, private heated whirlpools and a two-bedroom suite, Egyptologist-led sightseeing and three-, four- and seven-night cruises.
vessels.description:
The Oberoi Zahra is an ultra-luxury Nile cruiser with spacious rooms, private terraces, premium hospitality and unhurried visits to the sites. With only 28 cabins and suites, it is a peaceful, personal way to see the temples and tombs of Upper Egypt, with professional Egyptologists, private docking and premium vehicles for sightseeing.

Luxury Cabins measure about 26.4 m², with king or twin beds, a picture-frame Nile window and a rain shower with a view. Luxury Suites have 50 m² inside and a terrace with a heated whirlpool, about 115 m² in all, plus a lounge and private dining area. The two-bedroom Luxury Suite, about 92 m², sleeps four.

On board: a fine restaurant and lounge, a sun deck, relaxation areas, cultural presentations and Wi-Fi.
vessels.verification_note: The day-by-day itineraries were added to staging's existing test schedules ZLA4 and ZAL3, whose sailing days (Mon/Fri) and 100 departures were not set from Oberoi's dates. The two-bedroom suite sleeps 4 (Oberoi): cabins now allow 4, so set it to 4 in the admin, as the import only adds missing cabin types. Oberoi's deck plan (checked 5 November 2026) shows 25 Luxury Cabins and 2 Luxury Suites, 27, before the two-bedroom suite; Oberoi now says 28, so ask for its current plan and where that suite is. The plan also gives 72 × 14.4 m and shows a lift: add both, and mention the lift for guests with limited mobility. Seven-night and low-water itineraries not imported. Verify suite counts, departures, inclusions and cancellation terms. Staging also has a duplicate private record 'the-oberoi-zahra-luxury-nile-cruiser'.
